# Notipus

> Notipus turns payment and subscription webhooks from Stripe, Shopify, and Maxio (formerly
> Chargify) into enriched Slack notifications. Each alert includes customer context — company
> background, contact name and role, lifetime value, tenure — plus insight flags like VIP,
> at-risk, LTV milestones, and trial conversions. Source-available; self-host for free or use
> the managed service at https://app.notipus.com.

Key facts:

- Ingests payment/subscription webhooks from Stripe, Shopify, and Maxio (formerly Chargify),
  with signature validation on every webhook. Delivers Slack Block Kit messages with action
  buttons that deep-link back to the originating dashboard.
- Events covered: new subscriptions, payment success and failure, refunds, upgrades and
  downgrades, trial start/ending/conversion, cancellations and reactivations, Shopify orders,
  fulfillment with real carrier status, order-delivered confirmations (UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL,
  and other recognized carriers), and new customers.
- Enriches automatically: company data (logo, industry, size, founding year) and, on Pro and
  Enterprise plans, person data (name, job title, seniority, LinkedIn) from the customer email.
- Badges customer emails by domain type: education, government, military, healthcare, free
  provider, or disposable.
- Detects insights only when the webhook data supports them: lifetime-spend insights (LTV
  display, VIP, milestones, at-risk) come from Maxio and Shopify payloads — Stripe events
  carry no lifetime spend, so Stripe alerts never guess at it. First-payment callouts are
  customer-scoped for Shopify (order count) and subscription-scoped for Stripe (first invoice
  of a subscription). Upgrades and downgrades include the previous plan; payment retries show
  the next retry date.
- Reduces noise: related events are consolidated and deduplicated into a single message.
- Delivers reliably: failed notification deliveries are queued and retried automatically for
  up to 6 hours, with duplicate suppression.
- Secures data end to end: webhook signatures verified on every delivery, integration
  credentials encrypted at rest (ChaCha20-Poly1305), cached customer details encrypted in
  Redis.
- Formats amounts correctly in every currency, including zero-decimal (JPY, KRW) and
  three-decimal (BHD, KWD) currencies.
- Setup: sign in with Slack, then connect a provider. Stripe and Shopify connect with
  one-click OAuth (webhooks created automatically); Maxio uses a pasted webhook secret. The
  whole onboarding takes under a minute.
- Pricing: Free ($0, 20 events/month), Basic ($29/month), Pro ($99/month, adds person
  enrichment), Enterprise ($299/month, SLA). Paid plans include a 14-day trial.
- Operated by Viktopia UK Ltd, Bristol, England. Contact: support@notipus.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://notipus.com/): Product overview with example enriched Slack alerts and the
  onboarding screencast
- [Integrations overview](https://notipus.com/integrations/): What each provider integration
  covers, with a 44-second setup video
- [Stripe + Slack](https://notipus.com/integrations/stripe/): Stripe events, one-click OAuth
  setup, and what each event becomes in Slack
- [Shopify + Slack](https://notipus.com/integrations/shopify/): Shopify order, customer, and
  fulfillment events, including carrier-confirmed delivery alerts
- [Maxio (Chargify) + Slack](https://notipus.com/integrations/maxio/): Maxio subscription,
  renewal, and dunning events — the deepest coverage of the three providers
- [Pricing](https://notipus.com/pricing/): Plans, event limits, and billing details
- [FAQ](https://notipus.com/faq/): Common questions about events, context, security, and
  delivery reliability
- [Privacy policy](https://notipus.com/privacy/): UK GDPR privacy policy
